title: How Copilot Studio Skills load
subtitle: Copilot Studio matches a Skill to the scenario, then loads its full content when needed.

steps.title: Package the Skill content
steps.evidence: A Skill can contain SKILL.md plus optional references, assets, templates, examples, and executable scripts bundled in its folder or upload.

steps.title: Route by name and description
steps.evidence: Copilot Studio evaluates the Skill name and description against the conversation, then loads the full instructions when the scenario matches.

steps.title: Load full instructions on demand
steps.evidence: The agent uses each Skill's name and description to select it, then loads the full content on demand.
